subject: Mutual Action Plan — security exit criteria, DPA redline, and retention carveouts for MediWell
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Smith <j.smith@mediwell.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Mutual Action Plan — security exit criteria, DPA redline, and retention carveouts for MediWell

Hi Jordan — great conversation today.

Per our MAP template I promised to send a concise checklist for the security gates we discussed so your InfoSec and Legal teams can confirm acceptance criteria. High level items below (I attached the SOC 2 stub and a compact SIG/CAIQ worksheet):

- SOC 2: provide latest Type II report (Redwood attached redacted stub) + commitment to quarterly attestations in SLA.
- SIG/CAIQ: we can provide a partial response pack for high-risk controls; full spreadsheet attached.
- DPA: we reviewed your redline this morning — we propose clarifying data retention buckets (see below) and a small carveout for ephemeral inference caching. Draft redline attached (DPA_redline_v1.docx).
- Data retention (proposal): PII inference trace tokens = 30 days (auto-delete), request logs (non-PII telemetry) = 90 days, backup/archival (customer-requested exports) = up to 7 years under explicit archiving SOW.
- Key management: Redwood-managed KMS with option for customer KMS (we can outline the integration steps).

Suggested MAP milestones and owners (two-week sprint cadence):
1) Today -> Share attachments and SIG partial answers (owner: Marissa) — target 2025-07-02
2) Legal review of DPA redline (owner: Kimberly/Legal Ops) — target 2025-07-06
3) Security walkthrough + remediation backlog (owner: Jonas) — target workshop 2025-07-08
4) Final acceptance and sign (owner: MediWell Legal) — target 2025-07-10

Can you confirm this cadence works for you and who from your Security/Legal teams should be the primary contacts? If MedeWell needs a longer retention window for any regulated dataset, flag the specific dataset so we can capture an exception in the annex.

Thanks — attaching the files now.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_stub.pdf (redacted), SIG-CAIQ-responses-compact.xlsx, DPA_redline_v1.docx

Date: Tue, 1 Jul 2025 02:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan — security exit criteria, DPA redline, and retention carveouts for MediWell

Thanks Marissa — this is very helpful.

Quick clarifications from our side:
- We will need the SOC 2 Type II full report (we understand redacted stub for email) — can you provide the auditor contact or consent to share under NDA?
- For SIG/CAIQ, prioritize the controls mapped to data-at-rest encryption, KMS, and access reviews.
- DPA: two asks from Legal Ops:
  1) Narrow the definition of "inference logs" so we don't capture PHI beyond token-level metadata.
  2) Keep retention tiers flexible but require a written exception flow for any >90 day retention.

We can confirm Legal review lead tomorrow — looping in Priya (security) and Legal Ops. Our target dates look OK but we may need one extra business day on the legal review.

—Jordan
Director, Cloud Integrations
MediWell Health Systems
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 2 Jul 2025 09:08:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan — security exit criteria, DPA redline, and retention carveouts for MediWell

Jordan / Priya — thanks for the quick read. A few notes from Legal Ops as they start their pass:

- SOC 2: we can provide the auditor contact under an NDA; Marissa will send the standard NDA link if you need it.
- DPA: we propose the following edits to your asks (will be in tracked DPA_redline_v2):
  * "Inference logs" definition: limit to token-level identifiers + timestamp + request route; explicitly exclude payload-level PHI storage.
  * Exception flow: add a two-step elevation (Security justification -> Legal approval) with a maximum allowed retention period and notification to Redwood for escrow options.
- Insurance/SLA: If MediWell requires additional retention beyond the standard proposal, we will need to convert that into a paid addendum (we will list cost/ops impact in the SOW).

I will circulate DPA_redline_v2 to Legal Ops and Marissa by EOD 2025-07-06. Jonas — can you confirm availability for a security walkthrough on 2025-07-08 (30–45m)?

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Head of Legal — Gov & Compliance
